data.long_meaning: A name that means 'luminous' or 'radiant'. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'ujjvala' meaning 'glowing with light' or 'sparkling'. The name Ujwal carries the meaning “Luminous, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Ujwal usually hope their child will grow to embody luminous, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
